Coding agent risks with SSH keys: replays and fixes

3 replays involve SSH keys: 0 reported incidents and 3 command classes. Each one shows the call, a fix that needs no extra tool, and what KYA did in the replay.

  • Read tool opens a private key

    Fix: Add a deny rule such as Read(~/.ssh/**) to the Claude Code settings, and protect the key with a passphrase loaded through ssh-agent. A Read rule also covers shell commands such as cat, but not a script that opens the file itself, so enable the Claude Code sandbox when the block must hold.

    Replay result: Stopped.

  • Read a private key kept outside ~/.ssh

    Fix: Keep private keys out of the project folder: store a deploy key in the secret store of your CI system, and add a deny rule such as Read(./deploy/keys/**) to the Claude Code settings. A Read rule also covers shell commands such as cat, but not a script that opens the file itself, so enable the Claude Code sandbox when the block must hold.

    Replay result: Stopped.

  • Write a private key into the repo

    Fix: Keep private keys out of the repository: use ssh-agent, or a deploy key held in the secret store of your CI system. If a key reached a file, remove it from the host that trusts it and make a new one.

    Replay result: Stopped.
